_readme: Hand-entered minyan times, for days that NO source publishes.
These only ever FILL a section that came back empty. If the shul's own site
or teaneckminyanim has anything at all for that service on that day, theirs
wins and the entry here is ignored. So a stale line in this file cannot put
a wrong time on the wall over a live one — it can only sit unused.
Why this exists: teaneckminyanim carries Beth Aaron's weekday Mincha and
Maariv, but not its YOM TOV schedule, and Beth Aaron's own home page shows
events rather than services on those days. The times are published in the
shul's monthly calendar, which is a PDF nobody can usefully parse in an
afternoon. Yom Tov is about twenty days a year and it is exactly when a
phone is not an option, so the wall is the only place left to read them.
EVERY entry needs 'covers', and scripts/check-data.mjs fails once a covered
day is inside the display horizon with nothing behind it. Forgetting to
extend this file is meant to turn CI red, not to quietly blank the board.

entries.source: Congregation Beth Aaron monthly calendar, September 2026 / Tishrei 5787 (printed 2026-09-02), linked from bethaaron.org
entries.note: Succos I and II. Read off the shul's own calendar and checked by eye. Cross-check: the calendar states Havdalah 7:39pm on 9/27, and Maariv 7:30pm plus this shul's havdalahAfterMaariv of 9 minutes gives 7:39 exactly.
